notes: EngineeringStandard contract · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESIGN ONLY. v0.2.0 aligns with founder's Step 2 required fields: standard_id · version · title · rule · rationale · applicability · exclusions · evidence · benchmark · counterexamples · limitations · affected_languages · affected_project_types · introduced_at · supersedes · status · approval_reference · rollback_reference.

required_fields.name: schema_version
required_fields.shape: semver of the standard schema itself

required_fields.name: rule
required_fields.notes: Language Brain composes emission at runtime · rule is the meaning

required_fields.name: rationale
required_fields.shape: string · why this rule exists · references evidence + counterexamples

required_fields.name: exclusions
required_fields.notes: situations where the standard explicitly does NOT apply

required_fields.name: evidence
required_fields.shape: array of evidence_id from EvidenceBundle · benchmark + counterexamples
required_fields.notes: MANDATORY · at least 3 independent evidence records

required_fields.name: counterexamples
required_fields.notes: MANDATORY · at least 1 counterexample considered · demonstrates limits

required_fields.name: limitations
required_fields.shape: string · what the standard does NOT establish

required_fields.name: status
required_fields.notes: state transitions require NEW record · never edited in place

required_fields.name: approval_reference
required_fields.notes: MANDATORY · no standard enters feed without founder ADR reference

required_fields.name: rollback_reference
required_fields.notes: MANDATORY · rollback tested at emission time

optional_fields.name: external_references
optional_fields.shape: array of citations · sourced material used during research

hard_gate_before_emission: arbitration_id references an existing NEX3 record with verdict=NEX1_BETTER or NEX2_BETTER · or explicit LAB approval verdict
benchmark.pass_rate satisfies founder-authored threshold in approval_reference
approval_reference.founder_adr_ref resolves to a real ADR file
rollback_reference has been tested at least once
applicability + exclusions both present · applicability is NOT universal
invariants: append-only · a record is never edited in place
deprecation is a NEW record with status=DEPRECATED referencing predecessor
rollback is a NEW record with status=ROLLED_BACK referencing predecessor
SUPERSEDED means a newer standard replaced this one · not a delete
no standard applies universally · applicability field is mandatory
no standard enters the feed without founder-authored ADR reference
no standard is auto-authored by NEX · approval_reference.founder_adr_ref must resolve to a real ADR
no LLM in the emission path · attribution.external_llm_used=false
